audience: 3D visualization; downstream consumers must not need any knowledge of the upstream video-AI / neural-decode review system

behavior.note: primary derived label; precedence: rearing > locomotion > motor > nesting > quiet_wake; non-wake frames carry their sleep stage

seam_before.note: composition seam; do not interpret as a real transition

forbidden: any key matching *_prediction, prediction_*, *_conflict, conflict_*, model_* — predictions and conflict markers stay in the upstream review system and never enter this directory

connectivity.dynamic_edges: per-condition dynamic_edges.csv; rolling Pearson over real dF/F, top 30 undirected edges per frame by |r|; window = 10 frames (~5.2 s at 1.9231 Hz); activity correlation, NOT anatomical/synaptic
connectivity.neuron_positions: package-level neuron_positions.csv; real 2D ROI centers from Calcium imaging_Trace.mat
